monuments.name: Alma Mater
monuments.blurb: Green & Wright. The statue every Illini graduates under.

crown._note: Alma centre with her arms out before a klismos throne; Learning left and Labor right, standing behind it with their hands clasped over the throne back. Restored to bare bronze in 2014, so no patina. Floodlit from the four corners of the granite plinth. The synthesised footprint is 20 m square, so world units read directly here.

monuments.name: Illini Union
monuments.blurb: North head of the Main Quad. Registration and welcome desk.

crown._note: Georgian Revival: white painted trim on red brick, a dark slate roof, two brick chimneys, and one white octagonal cupola with a clock and a black dome cap. The eight-column portico and its pediment face the Quad.

monuments.name: Foellinger Auditorium
monuments.blurb: The domed rotunda closing the south end of the Quad.

crown._note: A 120 ft circular rotunda: limestone stylobate, brick drum, verdigris copper dome. The dome carries 396 embedded lights, drawn here as three rings that thin out towards the lantern. Six Ionic columns stand in the north portico, facing the Quad.

monuments.name: Altgeld Hall
monuments.blurb: Romanesque hall and chime tower on the west walk.

crown._note: Rusticated grey-tan limestone, not the orange sandstone the earlier pass assumed. The square 132 ft campanile stands at the Green and Wright corner, four corner turrets with conical caps around a red terracotta tile pyramid. The belfry loft glows: it holds the chimes. The hall behind it keeps a slate gable.

monuments.name: Siebel Center for CS
monuments.blurb: Engineering campus HQ. Atrium check-in and hardware bench.

crown._note: Reads at night as glass plus a green drum: a glass upper storey over the red brick base, the verdigris copper-clad cylinder at the north end, and lit floor bands where the labs run late.

monuments.name: ECE Building
monuments.blurb: Net-zero glass hall. Second-floor labs and balcony.

crown._note: Net-zero glass hall wrapped in vertical terracotta rain-screen fins, with a steel roof deck carrying the solar array. The floor bands are cool, not sodium, so they take the glass material and glow in its own colour.

Red brick under a grey standing-seam metal hip roof, with the long curved skylight strip along the ridge, two brick chimneys, and a semicircular window in each gable. The 24-hour reading room stays lit.

monuments.name: Digital Computer Lab
monuments.blurb: Loading dock and overnight supply runs.

crown._note: Buff brick with a concrete parapet and a flat roof. Cool-white lab bands rather than sodium windows, and the loading dock on the long facade where the overnight supply runs come in.

monuments.name: Kenney Gym
monuments.blurb: Main floor and bleachers. The largest hacking hall.

crown._note: Red brick gymnasium with limestone coping and a low gable. The clerestory band around the main floor is what shows from outside once the hall is full.

monuments.name: Memorial Stadium
monuments.blurb: South-west anchor. Shuttle staging and overflow parking.

crown._note: The bowl is U-shaped and open at the north, where the brick end pavilions stand; the horseshoe closes at the south. Grey-white stone colonnades run along both great halls, some two hundred columns in the real thing. Field green with Illini-orange end zones, and floodlight masts on both sidelines.

monuments.name: State Farm Center
monuments.blurb: The folded-edge dome. Closing ceremony venue.

crown._note: The folded-edge saucer: a low concrete drum, a scalloped rim of forty-eight tilted plates, and the shallow ribbed dome above. The dome top stays dark; the whole rim reads as a lit band, because that is where the concourse light spills out from underneath.

monuments.name: Main Library
monuments.blurb: Stacks and study halls south of the Quad.

crown._note: Georgian Revival like the Union: red brick, limestone cornice, slate hip roof with a row of dormers. The stack floors read as two lit bands.

Buff limestone and precast banded with dark granite, carrying two green-tinted glass towers rather than the single block the first pass drew. The arched limestone gateway with its lantern posts stands on the south approach.

monuments.name: Krannert Center
monuments.blurb: Performing arts terraces on the east flank.

crown._note: Cubic Brutalist massing in dark red-brown brick: a tall fly tower at one end, a low reflective glass pavilion at the other, and the wide white limestone terrace stairs across the front.
